Acala

Besides these verses found a. Acala's there are verses found a. Acaladāsa's, Acalasiṁha's an. Acalanṛsiṁha's; all these seem to refer to one an. the same poet; for Kvs. 320 Acala's is Acaladāsa's in Skm.; Śp. 784 an. 3564 Acala's are found a. Acalasiṁha's in Skm.
Similarly Acalarudra in Caturbhuja's anthology, Rasakalpadruma, (Alwar 1067. Extr. 225. p. 79) can also be identified with this Acala; for, the verse given here a. Acalarudra's is given a. Acala's in Śp. an. Padyāvalī.
Pracaladāsa an. Pracalasiṁha, Auf. I. 384a are mistakes for this Acaladāsa an. Acalasiṁha.
See also Skm. p.. 92 (Acalanṛsiṁha). 260. 261. 269. 270. 271. 273. 275 (Acalasiṁha). See also Kvs. Intro. p.. 18-19 an. Skm. Intro. p. 37.
